retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist white composition featuring a central translucent orb that erupts into a chaotic, colorful spray of geometric confetti and calligraphic strokes.
triggerTerms: minimalist white background with colorful shapes
excludeWhen: dark or heavy backgrounds are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, off-white canvas dominated by a central, semi-transparent circular form resembling a glass lens or orb. This central element acts as a focal point from which a dense, energetic cluster of primary-colored geometric shapes, squiggles, and thin black lines bursts toward the upper right corner, creating a sense of centrifugal motion and celebration.
coreVisualRelationships: Central translucent orb vs. high-energy peripheral explosion
Vast negative space vs. dense geometric cluster
Muted, smoky interior tones vs. vibrant primary-colored confetti
Rigid geometric squares vs. fluid calligraphic brushstrokes
coreInvariants: Diagonal movement from center to top-right
Mix of primary red, yellow, and blue accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large translucent orb is centered slightly below the middle; a dense cluster of shapes occupies the top-right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central 'eye' or core of the translucent orb.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central orb and is pulled upward and outward to the right by the trail of colorful shapes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space on the left and bottom-left creates a sense of airiness and focus.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Smoky grey and muted lavender (Central Orb)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Primary Red, Yellow, Blue, and Black (Confetti elements)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-saturation accents against a low-saturation, high-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary colors for the 'confetti' elements

letterConstructionRules: Wide-tracked, monolinear sans-serif for secondary titles
Thin horizontal rule lines used as dividers
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely wide letter spacing (tracking) for the title text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Classic high-contrast serif paired with a modern, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif.

preserve: Top-left alignment of the main name

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and elegant serifs match the primary text style.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Light or Gill Sans Light
candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric skeletons for the wide-tracked subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an off-white canvas with a central translucent, smoky-grey orb. Add a dense, diagonal explosion of primary-colored geometric shapes and black calligraphic lines from the center toward the top-right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a high-contrast serif name in the top-left corner with a thin horizontal line below it. Position a widely-spaced uppercase sans-serif title horizontally across the top-middle area.

verificationChecks: Is the background a clean, off-white color?
Is the central orb semi-transparent with visible internal layering?
Does the confetti explosion move diagonally toward the top-right?
Is the typography clean with significant letter spacing in the subtitle?

adjustableVariables: Transparency level of the central orb
Specific primary color balance (more red vs. more blue)
Thickness of the calligraphic black lines
mustRedesign: Avoid literal representations of objects; keep elements abstract.
Ensure the text does not overlap the dense part of the graphic explosion.

mustAchieve: A sense of 'controlled chaos' in the confetti
Clean, sharp edges on geometric shapes

postGenerationChecks: Confirm the presence of thin black calligraphic 'squiggles' within the explosion.
Ensure the central orb has a soft, diffused edge.
Check that the primary colors are vibrant and not muted.
Verify the horizontal rule line is perfectly straight and thin.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Minimalist White Background] + [Translucent Layered Sphere] + [Diagonal Primary-Color Geometric Burst] + [High-Contrast Serif Typography with Hairline Rules].
